concerns.text: FR-009 requires a 'pre-study pilot check' to validate task functionality before recruitment. Tasks T012 and T012.1 generate recruitment documentation (protocol/script) which is not required by any FR. The actual pilot validation logic is buried in T019.1, which incorrectly depends on T012/T012.1. This creates a circular dependency where documentation must be written before the pilot can run, blocking the FR-009 verification.

FR-009 mandates validating response times within '100ms - 5000ms'. Task T019.1 specifies validating SART Mean RT within a 'lower-bound-defined window up to 3000ms'. This contradicts the spec's upper bound (5000ms), potentially allowing slow outliers to pass the pilot check, failing to satisfy the FR.

FR-011 requires a sensitivity analysis comparing self-reported logs against objective screen-time data 'if available'. Task T038.2 only checks for the existence of `data/raw/objective_screen_time.json` and generates a limitation statement if missing. There is no task to implement the 'compare' logic for the positive case (when objective data exists), leaving the requirement partially unimplemented.

Plan Phase 2 mandates a fallback to Wilcoxon signed-rank tests if bootstrapping fails. Task T034 implements the fallback logic, but T034.1 (convergence detection) depends on T033.1 (bootstrap loop). However, there is no explicit task to implement the *execution* of the Wilcoxon test itself (beyond the conditional trigger), and the plan explicitly states 'Do not use Shapiro-Wilk to trigger this switch', yet T033.2/T062 are audits rather than implementation tasks for the fallback mechanism.

Tasks T012 and T012.1 generate `docs/recruitment_protocol.md` and `docs/recruitment_script_template.md`. These documents are not referenced by any Functional Requirement (FR-001 to FR-011) or Success Criterion. They represent scope creep and are not required to satisfy the spec.
